ops.body: Release config correction landed: cc-sync/phase2c @ ab9b0ac (pushed) — .goreleaser.yaml goos [darwin, linux] → [darwin], matching CI; no Linux port. Validated in ~/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/phase2c with GOWORK=off: goreleaser check passes; goreleaser release --snapshot --clean --skip=notarize,publish,announce succeeded, producing only darwin_amd64 + darwin_arm64 binaries/archives, checksums and the rendered cask (dist removed after). Plain goreleaser build stops at the notarize template for missing MACOS_* secrets — the intended fail-closed release gate. No other linux target exists in the repo; the remaining 'linux runner' mention is the release runner that cross-compiles darwin.
